the migration of the source code to the new library can be performed automatically by the means of automated program transformation, which is based on the analysis of the source code, the library interface and the transformation rules.
it is possible to automatically transform a program written using one library to another library, provided that the libraries have similar API.
the proposed approach is applicable to a variety of library environments, and it is possible to automate the process of source code migration between them.

the following problem: how to automatically transform the program source code to a new library environment, which is different from the previous one, and how to verify the correctness of the obtained result.

the following questions: 1) how the problem of automated migration between two different library environments can be formulated; 2) how this problem can be solved in practice; 3) how this problem solution can be implemented as a software system.

the following issues: 1) the development of a tool for automated program transformation; 2) the definition of a formal model of program transformation; 3) the development of an algorithm for transformation of programs.

automated program transformations are a very promising approach to the problem of migration to new library environments, which is a very important issue in modern software engineering, especially when it comes to software migration between different platforms and/or operating systems.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have implemented the tool that automatically transforms the source code of the application written in C++ and using the Qt library to a new environment with the Qt library.
it is possible to automatically migrate source code from one library environment to another one.

the migration process is based on the following steps: 1) the source code is transformed into an intermediate representation (IR); 2) IR is analyzed to find all library calls and to find all the library functions that are called by the source code; 3) the IR is transformed into a new representation, in which all library calls are replaced with new calls to the library functions from a new library environment.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is possible to automate the migration of software between library environments by applying a combination of program transformation techniques.
automated program transformation may be used to migrate code between two library systems.
the migration of source code to another library environment is a very complicated and challenging task, and it requires a lot of work.
